name: Shirahase Yuuna
source:
"N-No way. Yu♥Yu is forever."

[url=/c14905]Yuuta[/url] and Yuuna are two peas in a pod, and most people refer to them as YuYu (Although she secretly changes it to Yu♥Yu in her mind) 

Yuuna is an average human with no noteworthy characteristics. She has known Yuuta well since childhood, as they were next-door neighbors. They’re the same age, but she tends to depend on him like a big brother for the most part. 

Her family manages the Honeydew Cafe, and she’s always helping out. It’s rumored that the high volume of male customers is due in large part to this, despite being a confectionery. 

She cherishes the "proposal" (or something along those lines) that Yuuta made to her when they were kids. It would mean the world to this sweet and simple girl if this love could finally bloom. 

She is a 2nd year student at Shinonome Academy.
